name: 30YearWeather Widget
author: 30yearweather

sections.description:
30YearWeather Widget allows you to embed stunning, data-driven weather widgets on your WordPress site. Perfect for travel blogs, tourism websites, and destination guides.

Key Features

  • 470+ Cities Worldwide – From Paris to Tokyo, Bali to New York
  • 30 Years of Data – Based on NASA satellite historical records
  • Best Time to Visit – Help your readers plan their trips
  • Temperature Charts – Visual yearly temperature overview
  • Two Themes – Dark and light mode to match your site
  • Two Layouts – Classic (data-focused) or Visual (photo card)
  • Gutenberg Block – Easy drag-and-drop in the new editor
  • Shortcode Support – Works in classic editor too
  • Responsive – Looks great on mobile devices
  • No API Key Required – Just install and use

Use Cases

  • Travel blogs showcasing destination weather
  • Tourism websites helping visitors plan
  • Hotel and resort websites
  • Study abroad information pages
  • Wedding planning resources
  • Photography location guides

How It Works

The plugin embeds an iframe from 30yearweather.com that displays real-time weather data pulled from our servers. The data is based on 30 years of NASA POWER satellite observations, providing reliable historical averages.

Shortcode Usage

[30yearweather city="prague" theme="dark" width="400" height="450"]

Parameters:
* city – City slug (e.g., “paris”, “new-york”, “tokyo”)
* theme – “dark” or “light”
* layout – “classic” or “visual”
* content – Comma-separated sections: “bestMonths,climate,temperatures,rain,humidity,tourism”
* width – Widget width in pixels (200-800)
* height – Widget height in pixels (150-800)

Privacy

This plugin embeds content from 30yearweather.com via iframe. No personal data from your visitors is collected or transmitted. The embedded widget does not use cookies or tracking scripts.

For more information, see our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “30YearWeather Widget”
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Using the Plugin

Gutenberg Block:
1. Edit a post or page
2. Add a new block and search for “Weather Widget”
3. Select a city and customize settings in the sidebar
4. Publish!

Shortcode:
1. Add this shortcode to any post or page:
2. [30yearweather city="paris" theme="dark"]
3. Replace “paris” with your desired city slug
sections.faq:
What cities are available?

We support 470+ destinations worldwide. Popular cities include Paris, London, Tokyo, New York, Barcelona, Rome, Dubai, Bali, Sydney, and many more. Visit 30yearweather.com/widgets to browse all available cities.

Is this plugin really free?

Yes! The plugin is 100% free and always will be. We provide this as a service to the travel community.

Do I need an API key?

No API key is required. Just install, activate, and start using.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes! You can choose between dark and light themes, two different layouts (classic or visual), adjust the dimensions, and select which information sections to display.

Does this affect my site’s performance?

The widget loads via a lazy-loaded iframe, meaning it only loads when the visitor scrolls to it. This has minimal impact on your page load time.

Is the data accurate?

Our data is based on 30 years of NASA POWER satellite observations. We show historical averages and probabilities, not real-time forecasts.

Can I use multiple widgets on one page?

Absolutely! You can add as many widgets as you need, each showing a different city.
